text: In 1945 the kamikaze pilot Kōichi Shikishima [feigns technical trouble|trigger|running from trouble] to land on Odo Island, and when Godzilla attacks the garrison that night he [panics and fails to fire|wrong|failing to protect]. He returns to a Tokyo where bombing has killed his parents, takes in a woman named Noriko and [an orphaned baby, Akiko|images|babies, birth and pregnancy], and finds work clearing wartime mines. Meanwhile [Godzilla, mutated by American nuclear tests at Bikini Atoll|origin|monsters people made], heads for Japan.
